name: Gann's Reclamation
summary: In the southern Barrens, Gann Stonespire seeks travelers to strike back at Bael Modan. The wandering tauren exile was driven from his clan’s ancestral home and hunting grounds, and asks you to slay the dig’s workers and bring him its leader’s journal.

sections.title: A Displaced Tribe
sections.body: Gann Stonespire walks alone along the southern road, seeking bloody restitution for his fallen kin. His clan’s ancestral birthplace and hunting grounds lay among the red bluffs south of the Barrens. Dwarves from Ironforge came to build Bael Modan, and drove the tauren out or killed them to make room for quarries and trenches. Gann says peaceful protests and diplomacy failed. Now he seeks vengeance for the clan that was displaced and slain.

sections.title: The Ruins of Bael Modan
sections.body: At Bael Modan, dwarven excavators tear into the hills with steam engines and explosives. Prospector Khazgorm leads the dig deep into the earth. Gann asks you to thin the ranks of Bael'dun excavators and foremen, kill Khazgorm, and take the prospector’s personal excavation notes. He wants the notes to learn what the Alliance expedition seeks in the sacred soil.

faq.answer: Gann Stonespire is a solitary tauren survivor whose tribe once lived in the southern Barrens. After dwarven excavators drove his people from their land and killed those who resisted, he paces the southern highway, seeking justice and revenge against the Alliance dig site.

faq.q: Why are the dwarves in the Barrens?
aliases: why are dwarves at bael modan
faq.answer: The dwarves are an Ironforge expedition called the Bael'dun. They built a keep and excavation at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens, where their blasting and noisy machines tear apart the hills despite the native tauren inhabitants.

Prospector Khazgorm leads the dwarven excavation south of the Bael Modan fortress. Gann holds him responsible for the desecration of his ancestral grounds and demands Khazgorm’s journal as proof of his death.

faq.q: Where can Gann Stonespire be found?
faq.answer: Gann Stonespire paces along the road in the far southern Barrens, west of the Bael Modan fortress and north of the road toward the Great Lift and Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Did Gann try to resolve this peacefully?
faq.answer: Yes. Gann says he tried diplomacy and other peaceful avenues to stop the destruction of his ancestral lands. The dwarves dismissed those efforts and kept blasting the hills, so he turned to violence.

After Gann receives Khazgorm’s journal, he studies the prospector’s notes to understand the dwarves’ technology and plans. That leads into 'Revenge of Gann', where he seeks to sabotage their heavy machinery.

angles.text: As a Shu'halo, Gann’s plight is an infuriating reminder that the Alliance shows little respect for the Earth Mother. Dynamite and iron gears tear apart ancestral burial grounds.
As a member of the Horde, you see Bael Modan as a fortified Alliance stronghold deep in Kalimdor. Defending Gann’s claim is an act of honor and a way to contain that stronghold.
As a shaman, you know that Bael Modan’s blasting and deep trenches wound the surrounding earth spirits. Gann’s campaign is a necessary cleansing of that elemental disruption.
